field.label: Enable
field.help: Send the domains resolved by Unbound to the worker. Only domain names are sent, never client addresses.

field.label: Worker URL
field.help: Base URL of the shopguard-worker container.

field.label: Mode
field.help: Observe only: suspicious domains are listed here. Block: they are also added to the Unbound blocklist.

field.label: Score threshold
field.help: Domains scoring at least this value (1 to 100) are considered fake shops.
